title: Headhunter/Gameplay
text:
You can refer to these pages for controls and maps throughout the game. The controls are broken down by system, and the complex maps are broken into subsections.

LEILA Training
Before you begin the game, you'll have the option of running through the LEILA tutorial, which will let you master the basics of controlling Jack. You don't have to do it, and to a certain extent it breaks up the narrative of the game a little, but it is worth it for mastering some of the finer points of control.
